rfq_id.description: Paradigm-issued RFQ id; scopes the subscription to a single RFQ

ChannelsRfqRfqIdSubscribeDeribitCostBuyS.description: Why this direction has no cost. NO_SIZE, INSUFFICIENT_SIZE and PRICED are one scale: nothing resting, some but not enough, enough. NOT_LISTED means Deribit does not list the instrument. NO_DATA means it does and no price has reached us, which is not an empty book and must not be drawn as one
ChannelsRfqRfqIdSubscribeDeribitCostBuyS.title: ChannelsRfqRfqIdSubscribeDeribitCostBuyStatus

ChannelsRfqRfqIdSubscribeDeribitCostSell.description: As buy_status, for selling the structure instead of buying it
ChannelsRfqRfqIdSubscribeDeribitCostSell.title: ChannelsRfqRfqIdSubscribeDeribitCostSellStatus

buy_available.description: Structure units resting at Deribit's top of book: the smallest, across premium legs, of that leg's available amount over its ratio. Travels with INSUFFICIENT_SIZE so a client can name the gap rather than only assert one

buy_cost.description: Signed USD total for the whole quantity, oriented like a structure price: positive is a debit, negative a net credit. Absent unless this direction's status is PRICED. A zero is a real price, for a structure whose legs offset, and is not the same as an absent figure

buy_status.description: Why this direction has no cost. NO_SIZE, INSUFFICIENT_SIZE and PRICED are one scale: nothing resting, some but not enough, enough. NOT_LISTED means Deribit does not list the instrument. NO_DATA means it does and no price has reached us, which is not an empty book and must not be drawn as one

last_updated_at.description: Unix ms of the OLDEST leg tick behind the figure, since a structure is as stale as its worst leg. Absent whenever no tick backs it, which is every NOT_LISTED and NO_DATA. Use it to tell a live figure from a frozen feed, not to tell whether the reference is still arriving

sell_available.description: As buy_available, for selling the structure instead of buying it
